note.zh-TW: 同一張名詞卡也用於「流動負債合計」列。
note.en: The same card serves the total current liabilities line.

definition.zh-TW: 一年內要償還的債務，例如應付帳款、短期借款與應付所得稅。模板的分組標題，也是流動比率與速動比率的分母。
definition.en: Obligations due within a year, such as trade payables, short-term borrowings and current tax. A template group heading and the denominator of the current and quick ratios.
